title: I'm Not Okay (I Promise)
lyrics:
[00:26.64]Well, if you wanted honesty
[00:29.00]That's all you had to say
[00:32.02]I never want to let you down
[00:34.42]Or have you go, it's better off this way
[00:37.78]For all the dirty looks
[00:39.99]The photographs your boyfriend took
[00:42.65]Remember when you broke your foot
[00:44.92]From jumping out the second floor?
[00:47.67]I'm not okay
[00:51.79]I'm not okay
[00:57.09]I'm not okay
[01:02.43]You wear me out
[01:09.26]What will it take to show you
[01:11.30]That it's not the life it seems? (I'm not okay)
[01:14.59]I've told you time and time again
[01:16.95]You sing the words, but don't know what it means (I'm not okay)
[01:20.41]To be a joke and look
[01:22.56]Another line without a hook
[01:25.23]I held you close as we both shook
[01:27.56]For the last time, take a good hard look
[01:30.21]I'm not okay
[01:34.38]I'm not okay
[01:39.69]I'm not okay
[01:44.90]You wear me out (Out)
[02:07.77]Forget about the dirty looks
[02:10.48]The photographs your boyfriend took
[02:13.19]You said you read me like a book
[02:15.61]But the pages all are torn and frayed now!
[02:18.61]I'm okay, I'm okay!
[02:27.92]I'm okay now (I'm okay now)
[02:33.09]But you really need to listen to me
[02:35.09]Because I'm telling you the truth!
[02:36.98]I mean this, I'm okay! (Trust me)
[02:39.59]I'm not okay
[02:43.53]I'm not okay, well, I'm not okay, I'm not o-fucking-kay!
[02:48.83]I'm not okay
[02:54.28]I'm not okay ('Kay)
